about: LinkMia's own list of PortMiami cruise terminals. The address search shows matching terminals ABOVE Google's suggestions (js/curated-places.js), and the server writes the terminal's unambiguous label on verified bookings (backend/functions/lib/curated-places.js). One record per PHYSICAL terminal; a terminal lists every company that sails from it. A record WITHOUT verifiedAt is a DRAFT: never shown, never stored. Verified means Andres confirmed the company->terminal assignment and the placeId resolves to that terminal. Names, addresses and assignments are LinkMia's own text, sourced from PortMiami's official pages (miamidade.gov/portmiami: 'Cruise Terminals' and 'Directions to PortMiami', read 2026-10-27) and from Andres's first-hand knowledge; placeId is a Google place ID kept as an identifier only. No Google-returned text, coordinates or other Google content is stored here.

terminals.name: PortMiami Terminal V
terminals.source: Assignment: PortMiami Cruise Terminals page (Virgin Voyages' Terminal V) and Andres, LM-EFFA brief 2026-10-26. Address: Andres's brief 2026-10-26 (718 N Cruise Blvd); PortMiami's Directions page prints 'Cruise Terminal V: 718 W. Cruise Blvd.'; shown that difference, Andres re-confirmed 718 N Cruise Blvd on 2026-10-27 (stored address stands). Place ID: Google place ID kept as an identifier only, resolved 2026-10-26; canonical-echo check through /api/quote-ride is part of the Deploy Preview smoke matrix.
